name: Ashirwad Steels & Industries Limited
about: Ashirwad Steels & Industries Limited engages in the investment and lending business in India. The company invests in shares, bonds, debentures, mutual funds, and securities; short-term financing; and is involved in money lending activities. It also operates LPG bottling plant in Chhattisgarh. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.
